ComparisonReport is a Pydantic BaseModel with all 8 required fields: world_day (int), agent_id (str), tick_type (EventCategory), deterministic_output (AppraisalOutput), shadow_output (AppraisalOutput), shadow_llm_used (bool), shadow_failure_reason (Optional[str]), verdict (ComparisonVerdict).
run_comparison(input) returns a ComparisonReport for any valid AppraisalInput.
